executionOwner: Node scripts (ops-watchdog, summarize-pending, crawlee-worker, backfill-*, admin-command-worker-p1)
selection.rationale: lower-risk first target: append/upsert only, one row per key, no read-modify-write, no delete in the writer, single call path through recordWorkflowHeartbeat, and only one authoritative SECURITY DEFINER RPC with small explicit service-layer gates

rejectedDeferred.reason: writer has read-before-write dedupe and a delete/prune path; needs a slightly broader compatibility contract (natural M11.4)

rejectedDeferred.surface: admin_jobs/admin_job_events, admin_command_*, P5 evidence, MasterDash, llm_settings
rejectedDeferred.reason: mutable queue/state machine or upsert state; higher risk

securityModel.reachability: publicly reachable only via the workers.dev endpoint (workers_dev=true); preview URLs disabled (preview_urls=false); no routes/route and no custom domain
securityModel.internalOnlyPeer: worldcons-search remains internal-only (workers_dev=false, Service Binding only)
roleSeparation: Node/GitHub holds only the boundary bearer, never a Supabase credential for this path
boundary Worker resolves D1/Supabase authority independently from its own var
Supabase credential stays only in internal worldcons-search as in M9
securityModel.d1FailureBehavior: fail closed (503); never silently downgraded to Supabase
securityModel.sqlInjectionPosture: parameterized upsert; no caller value enters SQL text
securityModel.supabaseWritePath: rest/v1/rpc/ops_workflow_heartbeat_v1 (service_role has SELECT only on the table)

preservedAuthority.rollback: set WORLDCONS_OPS_HEARTBEAT_WRITE_AUTHORITY=supabase (disables the seam and restores the local RPC); no schema/data change. Unsetting WORLDCONS_OPS_WRITE_BASE_URL alone is not a rollback: the seam stays enabled but unconfigured and fails closed

reusedPatterns.privateBridge: M9 worldcons-search internal Service Binding + Supabase credential

verification.pnpmCheck: pre-existing unrelated failure (summary drain workflow must run on its own schedule)

liveCanaryPrerequisites: deploy worldcons-search with /internal/ops-heartbeat/write; it stays internal-only
deploy worldcons-ops-write with a set OPS_WRITE_TOKEN and resting authority supabase; confirm workers.dev /health requires the bearer and preview URLs are disabled
set WORLDCONS_OPS_WRITE_BASE_URL/TOKEN on the GitHub/Node runner and capture baseline counts with the Node-side authority at supabase

coordinate both authority vars to d1-canary (Node side and boundary Worker var); drive one heartbeat with run_id=m11-ops-heartbeat-canary via a controller-issued authenticated POST /v1/ops/heartbeat (recordWorkflowHeartbeat derives run_id from the CI env and cannot emit the canary id): D1 +1 / Supabase unchanged
coordinate both authority vars to d1 with an ordinary heartbeat: D1 +1 / Supabase unchanged (may be blocked by execution environment)
roll both authority vars back to supabase: Node sends nothing to the boundary and the local RPC path resumes
delete the canary row and restore pre-canary counts
blockers: no Cloudflare/DB credential access in this environment; controller owns the live canary

write-only migration: getWorkflowHeartbeats readers (lib/ops/watchdog.ts, app/api/masterdash/health/route.ts) still read Supabase, so a full d1 write authority would leave those reads stale; needs a separate M11 read-authority parity step
admin_ops_events deferred to M11.4 (read-before-write dedupe + prune contract)
M11 not globally complete: ingest and core/publication remain pending
next: live canary by controller; then M11.4 admin_ops_events with a bounded read+dedupe+prune compatibility contract
